source_name: The Banker — "Bank of the Year" country award for Montenegro
why_relevant: International award with an explicit Montenegro country category; the winning submissions and citations describe the digital/payments projects banks chose to showcase, which frequently names the technology partner behind them. CKB (OTP Group) observed as Montenegro winner for 2025.

source_name: Global Finance — Best Bank / Best Digital Bank awards, Montenegro country entry
why_relevant: Publishes annual country winners including Montenegro (CKB named best bank in Montenegro for 2026 per ME press) and separate digital-bank / payments categories. Award write-ups are a low-cost proxy for which digital initiatives banks consider flagship.

source_name: Money Motion (Zagreb) — Adriatic/CEE fintech conference, exhibitor and speaker lists
why_relevant: The largest Adriatic fintech event (2025: 2,500+ participants, 120 speakers, 40 exhibitors) and the regional venue where vendors selling into Montenegro exhibit even when they skip ME-local events. Exhibitor list plus sponsor tiers (Mastercard, Erste, RBI observed) is a regional competitor map; ME banks attend as delegates.

source_name: Central Bank of Montenegro (CBCG) — conferences, speeches and regional events
why_relevant: CBCG co-organises and hosts regional payments events (e.g. the Feb 2026 Podgorica regional conference on AML/CFT and anti-fraud for instant payments, 40+ WB central bankers, with European Commission, European Payments Council and World Bank speakers) and runs its own annual award competition. Agendas name which institutional and vendor actors are shaping ME instant-payments policy.

source_name: BIS central bankers' speeches — Montenegro event speeches mirror
why_relevant: Free, permanent, machine-readable mirror of CBCG governor speeches delivered AT conferences, including the venue, co-organisers and audience composition. Useful when the ME organiser's own site publishes no agenda.

source_name: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore (UBCG) — Association of Banks of Montenegro
why_relevant: The sector body that convenes ME banks; its news/events stream is the natural home for member conferences, seminars and vendor-hosted trainings, and for joint bank-vendor initiatives (card schemes, instant payments) announced collectively.

source_name: Privredna komora Crne Gore — Association of banking, other financial organisations and insurance / event organisation
why_relevant: Chamber of Economy runs a standing banking/finance/insurance association and an event-organisation function; it is strategic partner of IT SPOT and co-organiser of the Sustainable Finance Forum with CKB. Its event calendar names participating banks and supplier companies.

source_name: EKIP (Agency for Electronic Communications and Postal Services) — Conferences page
why_relevant: Telecom/postal regulator that hosts national digital-infrastructure conferences; postal operators and telcos are payments-adjacent actors in ME (Pošta Crne Gore, m:tel), and these agendas name digital-identity and e-signature suppliers relevant to payments onboarding.

source_name: paytech.events — global fintech/banking/payments conference calendar
why_relevant: Aggregator that indexes payments and banking events by region and date; useful to discover SEE/Adriatic events (and their sponsor pages) that no ME-local source lists, and to build a forward calendar for pre-event monitoring.

source_name: BANCEE — CEE banking conference
why_relevant: CEE-wide banking conference whose sponsor/partner roster and speaker list include the regional banking groups that own ME subsidiaries (OTP, NLB, Erste, RBI). Group-level vendor selections cascade into Montenegro, so this is an early-warning source for ME procurement.

source_name: CdM (Café del Montenegro) — economy section, awards and conference coverage
why_relevant: High-traffic ME general news outlet whose economy desk reports bank awards and conference outcomes in Serbian/Montenegrin, often with quotes from bank executives naming the technology partner. Broad safety-net for events the trade press misses.

source_name: MINA news agency — business/tech wire (event announcements)
why_relevant: National news agency that carries the original announcements for ME conferences (observed: IT SPOT announcement and the IT Spot portal launch). Agency copy is often the earliest public notice of an event and its organising partners.

source_name: Conference LinkedIn / Facebook pages (INFINTECH, IT SPOT, Privredna komora, Digitalizuj.Me)
why_relevant: Event social pages publish sponsor-logo announcements, booth photos and speaker cards that never make it onto the event website, and comment threads reveal exhibitor staff. Frequently the only surviving record of past-edition sponsor rosters once the site is rebuilt for the new year.

source_name: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive snapshots of ME event sponsor pages
why_relevant: Event sites overwrite the sponsor and speaker pages every edition, destroying the year-over-year series this cell depends on. The archive is the only way to reconstruct historical sponsor tiers for INFINTECH, IT SPOT and Spark.me and to date when a vendor first entered the ME market.

source_name: Bankar.me — Bankarstvo / Crna Gora category
why_relevant: The only specialised Montenegrin banking/finance portal. Publishes bank product launches, SEPA/TIPS rollout coverage, digitalisation investments and named-vendor stories that never appear in English. Confirmed article on SEPA at Prva banka and on the 2025-2029 FinTech Strategy.

source_name: Bankar.me — INTERVJUI (interviews) section
why_relevant: Highest-value sub-section for A6: long-form interviews with bank executives, CBCG payment-system leadership (e.g. Valentina Bulatović, CBCG payment systems & fintech directorate) and local IT vendor founders, in which systems, platforms and suppliers get named explicitly.

source_name: Bankar.me — Digitalizacija tag
why_relevant: Pre-filtered topical stream on banking digitalisation — the cheapest high-precision feed for bank IT investment stories in Montenegrin.

source_name: Bankar.me — conference / event coverage (Infintech, IT Spot, Tomorrow)
why_relevant: Conference write-ups enumerate the actor map: which local IT companies serve banks (e.g. Logate, organiser of Infintech, run by Ivica Tatar), which banks send speakers, and which fintech topics are commercially live. Strong snowball seed into vendor websites and sponsor lists.

source_name: MINA Business (Agencija MINA) — economic newswire
why_relevant: Montenegro's only national news agency; MINA Business is the wire that most other outlets republish, so it is the earliest timestamp for bank/vendor announcements. Confirmed coverage of SEPA accession and PayPal market entry. Investicije and Privreda sub-feeds are directly on-topic.

source_name: MINA — new site instance (new.mina.news)
why_relevant: A parallel/new MINA front end appears in the index. Relevant because the canonical MINA URL structure may migrate — a collector pinned only to mina.news risks silent breakage.

source_name: Dan — Ekonomija section (dnevni list Dan)
why_relevant: Daily newspaper with an economy desk that covers banking-sector health, supervisory disputes and procurement controversy — often the outlet that surfaces contested or critical angles on bank IT spending that promotional outlets omit.

source_name: Pobjeda — daily, business/tech coverage
why_relevant: State-linked daily of record; confirmed to run fintech market-entry stories (Montenegro among first Balkan markets for a new fintech app). Useful for official-channel announcements and government/CBCG-sourced digitalisation news.

source_name: Vijesti — leading independent daily/portal
why_relevant: Montenegro's most-read independent outlet; the standard destination for bank contract, tender-dispute and corporate-governance reporting. Named in the cell brief; economy sub-path is the standard vijesti.me URL pattern. Not directly confirmed in this run's result set — treat URL as high-confidence but unverified.

source_name: Portal Analitika — Ekonomija
why_relevant: Montenegro's first news portal (founded 2009), with an economy desk covering World Bank forecasts, foreign capital and banking. Adds an analytic/commentary layer and occasionally covers foreign ownership of banks (e.g. Turkish capital), useful for ownership-driven vendor preferences.

source_name: eKapija Montenegro (me.ekapija.com)
why_relevant: Regional B2B investment portal with a Montenegro edition: investment/project pipeline, financing news, tenders, and a company catalogue that carries structured entries for Montenegrin banks (confirmed entry for Societe Generale banka Montenegro). One of the few places where deal-shaped, machine-parseable business data exists in sr.

source_name: eKapija regional (ekapija.com) — Montenegro news + Finansije business opportunities
why_relevant: The regional eKapija carries a Montenegro news stream and a Finansije business-opportunities feed; confirmed article on banks from Serbia and BiH establishing direct payment links with Universal Capital Banka — exactly the correspondent/partnership signal this cell targets.

source_name: Ekonomist (ekonomist.me) — Montenegrin fintech/business magazine
why_relevant: Podgorica online magazine founded 2014, described as Montenegro's only dedicated fintech portal — a business-and-technology platform. Naturally biased toward exactly the vendor/technology/partnership content this cell wants, and not in the brief's original outlet list.
